priority_basis: Current product page is published but has no verified external traffic or sales. Evergreen, high-intent free articles can create organic discovery and direct readers to the paid product without advertising spend.

article.topic: YouTube AI Shorts monetization, mass-produced content policy, AI disclosure

automation_review.direct_execution: Both article drafts, source links, tracked CTAs, validation, and launchers are completed in the repository.
automation_review.official_api: note does not have a connected authenticated publishing action in the current tool set.
automation_review.browser_prefill: Mobile HTML launchers copy the prepared title and body and open https://note.com/new.
automation_review.batching: Each article's title, body, source links, product CTA and editor launch are consolidated into one page.
automation_review.verification: CI validates title/body, source presence, CTA presence and absence of placeholders.
automation_review.credentials: No credentials, cookies or personal data are stored.

residual_user_action.reason: Final publication in the user's note account requires the authenticated account holder.
steps_per_article: Open the generated launcher and copy the prepared article.
Open the note editor, paste the title/body and confirm final publication.

success_condition: At least one free article is publicly available and its CTA links to the paid product.
next_assistant_actions: After either publication, add the public article URL to distribution and metrics tracking.
Do not create a third funnel article before the two prepared articles have publication or seven-day traffic evidence.
